verdict.rationale: Airwallex's docs show very broad API coverage across nearly all core UI functions—accounts creation, cards/issuing, expenses, bills, transfers/batch transfers, FX, banking-as-a-service, webhooks, plus SDKs and a CLI—suggesting strong API/UI parity. However, there is no explicit vendor statement guaranteeing 1:1 parity across every UI feature, and no independent or hands-on confirmation that no UI-only actions exist. Missing for 10: an explicit parity claim/documentation of any UI-only features, and independent verification that all UI workflows are fully API-replicable.
